title: CPF Module Schema: MSSQL ElasticPool Module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-mssqlelasticpool'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

enclave_type.description: (Optional) Specifies the type of enclave to be used by the elastic pool. When enclave_type is not specified (e.g., the default) enclaves are not enabled on the elastic pool. Possible values are Default or VBS. All databases that are added to the elastic pool must have the same enclave_type as the elastic pool. enclave_type is not supported for DC-series SKUs.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

license_type.description: (Optional) Specifies the license type applied to this database. Possible values are LicenseIncluded and BasePrice.

maintenance_configuration_name.description: (Optional) The name of the Public Maintenance Configuration window to apply to the elastic pool. Valid values include SQL_Default, SQL_EastUS_DB_1, SQL_EastUS2_DB_1, SQL_SoutheastAsia_DB_1, SQL_AustraliaEast_DB_1, SQL_NorthEurope_DB_1, SQL_SouthCentralUS_DB_1, SQL_WestUS2_DB_1, SQL_UKSouth_DB_1, SQL_WestEurope_DB_1, SQL_EastUS_DB_2, SQL_EastUS2_DB_2, SQL_WestUS2_DB_2, SQL_SoutheastAsia_DB_2, SQL_AustraliaEast_DB_2, SQL_NorthEurope_DB_2, SQL_SouthCentralUS_DB_2, SQL_UKSouth_DB_2, SQL_WestEurope_DB_2, SQL_AustraliaSoutheast_DB_1, SQL_BrazilSouth_DB_1, SQL_CanadaCentral_DB_1, SQL_CanadaEast_DB_1, SQL_CentralUS_DB_1, SQL_EastAsia_DB_1, SQL_FranceCentral_DB_1, SQL_GermanyWestCentral_DB_1, SQL_CentralIndia_DB_1, SQL_SouthIndia_DB_1, SQL_JapanEast_DB_1, SQL_JapanWest_DB_1, SQL_NorthCentralUS_DB_1, SQL_UKWest_DB_1, SQL_WestUS_DB_1, SQL_AustraliaSoutheast_DB_2, SQL_BrazilSouth_DB_2, SQL_CanadaCentral_DB_2, SQL_CanadaEast_DB_2, SQL_CentralUS_DB_2, SQL_EastAsia_DB_2, SQL_FranceCentral_DB_2, SQL_GermanyWestCentral_DB_2, SQL_CentralIndia_DB_2, SQL_SouthIndia_DB_2, SQL_JapanEast_DB_2, SQL_JapanWest_DB_2, SQL_NorthCentralUS_DB_2, SQL_UKWest_DB_2, SQL_WestUS_DB_2, SQL_WestCentralUS_DB_1, SQL_FranceSouth_DB_1, SQL_WestCentralUS_DB_2, SQL_FranceSouth_DB_2, SQL_SwitzerlandNorth_DB_1, SQL_SwitzerlandNorth_DB_2, SQL_BrazilSoutheast_DB_1, SQL_UAENorth_DB_1, SQL_BrazilSoutheast_DB_2, SQL_UAENorth_DB_2, SQL_SouthAfricaNorth_DB_1, SQL_SouthAfricaNorth_DB_2, SQL_WestUS3_DB_1, SQL_WestUS3_DB_2. Defaults to SQL_Default.

max_size_bytes.description: (Optional) The max data size of the elastic pool in bytes. Conflicts with max_size_gb. One of either max_size_gb or max_size_bytes must be specified.

max_size_gb.description: (Optional) The max data size of the elastic pool in gigabytes. Conflicts with max_size_bytes. One of either max_size_gb or max_size_bytes must be specified.

per_database_settings.description: (Required) A per_database_settings block as defined below. object({ min_capacity = "(Required) The minimum capacity all databases are guaranteed." max_capacity = "(Required) The maximum capacity any one database can consume." })

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

server_name.description: (Required) The name of the SQL Server on which to create the elastic pool. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

sku.type: object({ name = string tier = string family = optional(string, null) capacity = number })
sku.description: (Required) A sku block as defined below. object({ name = "(Required) Specifies the SKU Name for this Elasticpool. The name of the SKU, will be either vCore based or DTU based. Possible DTU based values are BasicPool, StandardPool, PremiumPool while possible vCore based values are GP_Gen4, GP_Gen5, GP_Fsv2, GP_DC, BC_Gen4, BC_Gen5, BC_DC, HS_PRMS, or HS_Gen5" tier = "(Required) The tier of the particular SKU. Possible values are GeneralPurpose, BusinessCritical, Basic, Standard, Premium, or HyperScale." family = "(Optional) The family of hardware Gen4, Gen5, Fsv2, MOPRMS, PRMS, or DC" capacity = "(Required) The scale up/out capacity, representing server's compute units." })

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

zone_redundant.description: (Optional) Whether or not this elastic pool is zone redundant. tier needs to be Premium for DTU based or BusinessCritical for vCore based sku.

id.description: The Resource ID of the MS SQL Elastic Pool.

name.description: The Name of the MS SQL Elastic Pool.

resource.description: The MS SQL Elastic Pool resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Mssqlelasticpool' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
